rationale: Complete pinned HAMT/transient/sequence algorithm retained. Explicit defn, doto, if-let and exact forEach bootstrap preserve all branches and evaluation order; Error construction uses the typed adapter and threshold spelling follows the pinned emitter. Native execution/transport and broader compatibility remain unfinished. Original Suss: a return-only long hint exposes the guaranteed masked int32 result to primitive callers. The operands retain their original ToInt32 conversions; replacement functions still use each caller's guarded boxed fallback.
